# Linking the USD suspense split that settles the invoice exactly.
#
# The single-currency happy path: 100.00 arrived and 100.00 was owed, so there
# is no residue and nothing to convert. The split moves from the suspense
# account to the receivable and the invoice closes.
#
# What this fixture produces: the suspense split on
# `Assets:Accounts Receivable USD` at −100.00 USD, in the invoice's lot, the
# entry still USD and still balancing, and no suspense split left on the
# transaction.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-02
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789"
    txn_split_guid: "cdef0123456789abcdef0123456789ab"
